note: Measured 2026-10-26 on the gpu rung (Chrome 155, macOS arm64); the software rung renders the same frames slower and is compared with a note.

treatment.request: A README motion cover for LitCodex with a product object that opens.
treatment.idea: A case turns once and opens on its beat to show the lit core inside, beside a still name.
treatment.recipeReason: One object acting once per loop says what the project holds better than a type pattern.
treatment.hero: A rounded case with a hinged lid and a lit core.
treatment.beat: The lid opens, the core rises and settles, and the lid closes.

layers.slow: The case turns exactly once per loop.
layers.mid: The camera breathes twice per loop.
layers.beat: The lid opens on the core and a ring runs out across the floor.

system.rule: One hinge rule and one turn rule on one object.
system.copies: One case, one core, one ring.
system.offset: The ring trails the lid by a tenth of the loop.

treatment.ambition: The object reads as a product in a studio and its beat lands once per loop.
